learning_outcomes.text: Have basic information about the principles of production methods, their superiority over each other, application areas and equipment.

Gains the ability to choose the most suitable manufacturing method for a particular machine part at the design stage and to determine the most accurate working parameter for that manufacturing method.
Gains the ability to use applied knowledge in the field of manufacturing in solving complex engineering problems.

syllabus_topics: General Description and Classification of Manufacturing Technologies Conventional (Traditional) Manufacturing Methods - Chipless manufacturing methods -Machining methods Unconventional (Advanced) Manufacturing Methods - Machining methods with mechanical energy - Electrochemical energy processing methods - Processing methods with thermal energy …. etc.
Cutting Fundamentals Relationship between - Workpiece - Cutting Tool - Machine Tool - Cutting Parameters - Chip Formation
Shear Theory - Cutting Mechanics - Loads Affecting the Cutting Tool - Wear on Cutting Tools
Life Models and Cutting Tool Materials in Cutting Tools
Processing Economics - Processing Economics Inputs -Tool life economyof plastic deformation,The introduction of Plastic Forming Procedures.
Turning Operations - Lathes and used cutting tools - Metal removal factors in turning operation
Milling Operations - Milling machines and used cutting tools - Metal removal factors in milling
Hole Drilling Operations - Drilling Process - Machines Used in Drilling - Cutting Tools / Drill Bits Used in Drilling - Chip Removal Factors in Drilling
Finishing Methods and Cutting Fluids - Grinding Operations, Honing Operations and Lapping Operations - Cutting fluids used in machining, their duties, types
Geometric Tolerance and Surface Quality in Machining - Surface quality - Size (Dimension), Shape and Position Tolerance - Factors Affecting Tolerances and Surface Quality

Computer Aided Manufacturing - Computer Aided Design (CAD) - Computer Aided Engineering (CAE) - Computer Aided Manufacturing (CAM) - Computerized Numerical Control (CNC) - Structure and Features of CNC Machines
Programming CNC Machines - Coordinate Systems Used in CNC - Dimensioning Systems Used in CNC - Characters Used in CNC Program - Programming of CNC Lathe - Programming of CNC Milling Machine
Unconventional (Advanced) Manufacturing Methods - Using mechanical energy - Using heat energy - Using electrical energy - Using chemical energy, etc.
teaching_methods: Lecturing with classroom board and digital presentations
